description: Xiaomi Cloud (小米云服务) desktop client for Windows - sync photos, notes, contacts and drive files across devices.
##: Windows 64-bit build only; the vendor also publishes an ia32 installer and a macOS dmg.
The NSIS installer embeds the real app as $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; post_install expands it and removes installer leftovers.
checkver reads the Windows exe version from Xiaomi's client download page (locale=zh_CN).
autoupdate.hash is omitted: no checksum is published, so Excavator downloads the installer and computes the hash.
